affectedCopies: RouteDecisionLog readers that interpret inferenceDataScreenReceipt (admin route-decision log view, coworker panel notice)

migration.name: 20260906070000_index_route_decision_by_agent_message
migration.backfill: None. Adds CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS on RouteDecisionLog (agentMessageId, createdAt) so the coworker panel can resolve a thread's latest screen receipt without scanning the table. No column added, no row read, written or deleted; applies cleanly against any existing data state and is a no-op where the index already exists.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Routing audit record, retained on the existing RouteDecisionLog cadence. This change adds an index and one integer inside the existing inferenceDataScreenReceipt JSON payload; it creates no new retention obligation.

fields.reason: A payload index (the position of the last user-role message), not conversation content. It carries no personal or governed value and cannot be inverted into one — it says where the current turn begins, never what any message said. rawPayloadStored stays false, which is the invariant the receipt exists to hold.
Existing column; indexed only. No shape, meaning or population change.
